rejected_rule.statement: The amending Ordinance has retrospective effect and applies from the date of the passing of the main Ordinance in 1911.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "Having regard to these considerations, I am confirmed in the view that I expressed in the case of Satchithananda v. Sivaguru 2 [(1949) 50 N. L. R. 293.] that the amending Ordinance has retrospective effect and has effect from the date of the passing of the main Ordinance in 1911."
